purpose: Source identity and construction backlog for the architecture catalog: pinned upstream sources, mapping status, and per-row construction work. Not a support claim or executable benchmark configuration. Parity and performance evidence for the current rows is the training-harness campaign (results/sweep/, results/upstream/, results_report.md); the prior harness's per-row qualification artifacts were retired with it.

fla.audit: Source candidate is pinned by full Git revision. Direct unified-plan versus upstream parity and paired A10G profiles exist for linear attention, Simple GLA, GLA, DeltaNet, and Gated DeltaNet in results/unified-mixer/fla-k2.json. The loaded FLA module is 0.6.0 at this revision; the environment distribution metadata reports 0.5.2 and is recorded separately. These are kernel-slice results, not full-layer qualification.

xma.audit: Pinned XMA source includes pointwise SwiGLU activation, token MoE grouped projections and the RNN/GRU/M2RNN mixer recurrences; only its sequence-state recurrences are in K1/K2/K3 scope.

samba.audit: Pinned Samba source includes an executable no-PE attention branch profiled at Samba_421M dimensions. The Mamba/GLA/Retention alternatives, short-convolution and rotary paths, and complete Block/cache graph still require separate profiles.

fwpkm.audit: Pinned FastWeightProductKeyMemory source performs product-key top-k routing, retrieval from fast-weight values, and an inner SGD update with optional entropy/addressing loss and write clipping. It is outside the current K3 sparse-delta contract until those route and optimizer semantics are represented.

differential.audit: Differential Transformer V1 is pinned explicitly; V2 has a different lambda and normalization contract.

tda.audit: Pinned threshold differential attention Triton source; source implements normalized, causal power-two thresholded rectification with scalar beta and lambda.

tpa.audit: Pinned T6 CausalSelfAttention implementation; exact factorized Q/K/V, source RoPE, causal SDPA and output projection comparison recorded in tpa-k1.json.

tucker.audit: Pinned Tucker Attention Triton implementation; exact source identity and BF16 fused-kernel output/gradient/profile comparison recorded in tucker-k1.json.

longformer.audit: Pinned AllenAI sliding-chunks source; local no-global attention kernel profile uses upstream QK/PV functions. Full Longformer model import is blocked by the pinned code depending on a removed transformers.modeling_roberta import.

sparse_transformer.audit: Pinned attention.py dense all/local/strided equations and exact fixed-mode layout/callback semantics are checked and profiled through a TensorFlow 2 eager bridge. The optimized TensorFlow 1 BlocksparseTransformer traversal remains unavailable.

hla_higher_order.audit: Pinned Higher-order Linear Attention project repository. It contains a paper/project page but no executable operator or kernel.

kata.audit: Pinned KATA normalized positive causal attention and Triton backward kernels; exact output/gradient parity and 21-pair A10G profiles at BF16 B4/T1024/H8/D=64/M=4 are recorded in kata-k1.json.

atma.audit: Checkout identity only; benchmark worktree dirtiness and callable source hashes before use. Public repository confirmed against the pinned revision's tests (provision via extra/provision_comparators.py).

conformer.audit: Pinned ESPnet Conformer MultiHeadedAttention. Bidirectional standard self-attention with the source SDPA path matches the unified K1 plan exactly at FP32 B2/T1024/H4/D32; full Conformer convolution, positionwise FFN, positional encoding and residual block are outside this profile.

h3.audit: Pinned H3.forward and SSKernel filter generation run through the PyTorch FFT path. URM now matches the head_dim=1 training mixer with an independent two-stage K2 FFT adapter; head_dim>1, fast fused FFT convolution and inference cache/step remain open.

safari.audit: Pinned standalone HyenaOperator.forward and learned implicit-filter FFT path are executable and profiled at order 2; higher orders, low-precision fused FFT and streaming/cache remain outside the comparison.

hopfield.audit: Pinned HopfieldCore and hopfield_core_forward source. The single update_steps_max=0 association is a projected unscaled softmax K1 operation; exact source output/gradient and paired profile are in hopfield-k1.json.

maml.audit: Pinned Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning training algorithm source. The objective is inner-loop adaptation and outer meta-gradient optimization, not a sequence mixer.

reptile.audit: Pinned OpenAI Reptile training algorithm source. It performs task-specific training followed by parameter interpolation, not sequence mixing.
